name: Ellie Dutton
bio:
Ellie Dutton, the tattooist and proud owner of Elliedstattoos in Leigh, UK, is renowned for her exceptional professionalism in the industry. Specializing in illustrative and floral styles, she consistently ensures every aspect of the tattooing process meets the highest standards, from initial design to the finished piece. Clients can expect a seamless experience characterized by meticulous attention to detail, both in her art and her business dealings, making bookings exclusively through her official website.
